ACTION 31 OF 32 · PHASE 08

Run one expansion experiment

Find a controlled way to serve the next location or customer segment.

WHEN TO DO THISOnly when the home-market offer is repeatable and the unit economics work.ESTIMATED WORK TIMEDepends on partner/market
↗
Your one job

Find a controlled way to serve the next location or customer segment.

01

Do this now

  1. 01

    Choose one nearby market, segment or channel—not several at once.

  2. 02

    Decide the model: partner, reseller, licensing, white-label or directly-operated.

  3. 03

    Verify local compliance, staffing, payments, margins, quality controls and customer support.

  4. 04

    Pilot a limited offer and define an exit rule before hiring or committing to long contracts.

02

Copy this into ChatGPT

Replace anything in [square brackets] with your real business details. The prompt is a shortcut, not a substitute for the steps above.

READY-TO-USE PROMPT
Create a staged expansion pilot from [HOME MARKET] to [TARGET MARKET] using my actual fulfillment, profit and customer data. Compare direct operation, partnerships and white-label delivery. Identify laws, payment support, insurance, supplier and cultural factors to verify with local sources. Give a minimum-cost pilot, milestones, quality controls, fallback and go/no-go decision.
03

Finish with this

A small expansion plan with costs, responsible partner, success metric and stop condition.

Before moving on, check your work against the following:

  • Pilot is reversible
  • Cross-border operational assumptions verified
  • Quality and margins monitored
DON’T MAKE THIS MISTAKE

Treating a new country landing page as actual country operations.

READY TO MOVE ON?

A repeatable profitable process exists and the next investment is supported by measured results.
